scene.speaker: mateo
scene.bubble: The best hour of the day: after school! Bikes, the park, and Luna running behind us.
scene.intro: The best hour of the day: after school! Mateo likes riding his bike and skateboarding down the small hill. Erik likes reading science books and drawing his inventions, and he doesn't like watching TV. Both like playing outside until the sun goes down. What do YOU like doing after school? Tell us and find someone who likes the same thing!

activities.title: Listen. What does everyone do after school? Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Erik: After-school report! Monday and Wednesday I build my robots. … Mateo: I ride my bike every day. Yesterday I rode around the lake twice! … Erik: Valentina reads in the library on Tuesdays. She reads four books every month. … Mateo: Sofia flies her kite when it's windy. The orange one with a long tail. … Erik: And on Fridays we all meet at the park at four o'clock. … Mateo: With Luna! She catches the ball better than all of us. … Erik: Free time: officially the best time.
